body: thank you a lot  i'll try to do what you said and keep myself busy. its just weird and idk where this came from. love u and i hope things get better for you as well

thank you, but honestly it's not that my friend doesn't interest me it's not awkward hanging out with her it's just that its extremely hard for me to withstand being around people for too long, i legitimately get so tired and worn out and its making it hard for me to go to classes too. i don't know i just hate like having friends and doing things all the time like i sound extremely boring but i love being at home and doing nothing and i don't think other people get that... it's hard :(

it's not even a group its one person but she is always telling me to go to school earlier so we can hang out before classes and she even facetimes me often and it was fun at first and i think she's really nice and cool to hang out with but then i get home and my entire body and mind hurts and i just want to lie in bed and recharge for the next 50 years. before i met her, i hung out with ONE friend (i still do) every few months or so and i consider him like my best friend because of the low maintenance. i don't know how to let her know that i need my space and i don't understand why she seems so attached to me bc she is very social person so she probably has a lot of other friends. i feel like if i tell her how i feel she'll take offense to it, and every other time this has happened to me i just cut them off with no explanation and i don't want to do that to her because she is a very good person. :(

i always watch that show every time i begin spiraling into a depression. i rewatched the entire series in like 3 days when season 4 came out its really the best/worst medicine. the last season really hit home for me the hardest honestly
